items.headline: High Wind Watch issued October 6 at 1:52AM AKDT until October 9 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 40 to 50 mph with gusts up to 70 mph
possible.

* WHERE...St Lawrence Island.

* WHEN...From late Wednesday night through late Thursday night.

* IMPACTS...High winds may damage property and cause power outages.
Travel could be difficult, especially for high profile vehicles.

items.headline: Dense Fog Advisory issued October 5 at 9:38PM AKDT until October 6 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Visibility one quarter mile or less in dense fog.

* WHERE...Central Susitna Valley and Southern Susitna Valley.

* WHEN...Until 10 AM AKDT Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Hazardous driving conditions due to low visibility.
items.areas: Southern Susitna Valley; Central Susitna Valley
items.instruction:
A dense fog advisory means visibilities will frequently be reduced to
less than one quarter mile. If driving, slow down, use your
headlights, and leave plenty of distance ahead of you.

A high wind watch means there is potential for a hazardous high wind
